import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(99)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 4, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (4, 10))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
# 'value' is a numeric column with a known distribution: half the rows are in [0, 1], half in [9, 10].
df['value'] = np.where(np.arange(n) < n // 2, rng.uniform(0, 1, n), rng.uniform(9, 10, n))

steps.eval: document.querySelector('#tab-explore').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const valIdx = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'value').index; a.setHistColumn(valIdx)
